_comment: Personal config for .claude/hooks/*. Copy this file to .claude/local/hooks.config.json (gitignored) and edit. All fields optional — hooks fall back to safe defaults if absent.

journal_reminder._comment: PostToolUse hook (.claude/hooks/journal_reminder_on_plan_edit.py). Watches edits to *.md files directly in plans/ by default; this list adds extra filenames to watch outside plans/ (rare).
